description: This file contains an extension for NodeAppModel with static methods to normalize watch notification parameters, actions, risk, and priority, as well as a utility for trimming strings.

classes.name: NodeAppModel
classes.description: Extension of NodeAppModel providing static normalization methods.

methods.name: normalizeWatchNotifyParams
methods.description: Normalizes OpenClawWatchNotifyParams by trimming strings and setting priority and risk.

methods.name: normalizeWatchActions
methods.description: Normalizes a list of actions, providing default actions based on promptId and kind.

methods.name: normalizedWatchRisk
methods.description: Determines normalized risk based on provided risk or priority.

methods.name: normalizedWatchPriority
methods.description: Determines normalized priority based on provided priority or risk.

methods.name: trimmedOrNil
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string or returns nil if empty.
